text:
Ashley: Quick sync — need to lock down oncall handoff & triage cadence while INC-432 and INC-439 are active. Suggest daily 9:30am PST triage call (20m) until both incidents are resolved. I'll schedule if folks +1.

Marc: +1 for 9:30. Prefer daily while INC-432 is open.

Devon: I can do 9:30 M-F. Wed is tight (recurring meeting) — could shift to 10am that day if we need.

Sylvia: I'll join when INC-432 owner requests escalation. Otherwise a daily 15-20m handoff is fine.

Noah: We should include SRE lead and Support lead as escalation attendees. Also add a short agenda template.

incident-bot: INC-432 — GPU pool degraded. Pager acknowledged by @Devon at 1712349000. Status: investigating.

Ashley: Proposed agenda (keep it tight):
```
- Quick status & owner (2m)
- Current impact & user-facing symptoms (3m)
- Work in progress / mitigation (5m)
- Immediate next steps, rollbacks, or traffic routing (5m)
- Escalation / who to page overnight (2m)
```

Devon: Adding calendar placeholder: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/triage-temp — will update with Zoom + doc link.

Marc: Can we make this daily 7 days/week until INC-432 cleared? We saw pages overnight last night.

Sylvia: Agree — daily until cleared. Also propose a hard 20m timer so it doesn't drift.

Ashley: Great. I'll create a recurring 9:30am PST daily meeting for the next 7 days, 20m, include Zoom + agenda + incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/INC-432. Please accept or flag conflicts. :thumbsup:

Noah: I'll be oncall nights this week and will join the morning handoff at 9:30 to pass context. If pages come overnight, ping my mobile.

Devon: For escalation chain: oncall -> SRE lead (Marc) -> Eng lead (Sylvia) -> CTO on major degradation. I'll note that in the calendar invite.

Marc: I'll be the primary escalation contact after oncall.

incident-bot: Created meeting 1712349200: "INC-432 Triage (Daily)" — Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/j/123456789 — Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/e/abcd

Ashley: Assigning IC for today's call: Devon. Devon — please run triage and update the incident doc during/after the meeting.

Devon: Confirmed — I'll lead triage and update runbook section 'GPU-degrad' with findings and mitigations.

Sylvia: If anybody needs to add an agenda item, drop it in the incident doc or ping me directly before the call.

Ashley: Thanks all. If any conflicts on the invite, reply here and I can rotate to 10am Wed for those who need it.

Marc: Thanks — will join.

Noah: Acknowledged.

Devon: See you on the call.
